messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — we're locking analyst briefings for the Benchmark launch. Embargo is 2026-06-10T15:00Z. Please review the Quick Facts doc (link below) and claim any quotes you want to own. We need final approved quotes and fact-check sign-off before we share under embargo. Link (view-only): https://drive.google.com/open?id=benchmark-quickfacts-2026

Aaron Patel: I can own the latency/throughput quote. Will draft a tight 1-2 sentence quote and drop it here by EOD today. :thumbsup:

Lena Ortiz: I'll own the pricing/cost narrative and the analyst one-pager. Quick Q: does Legal need to sign off on every quote or just final copy for the press packet?

Jordan (Legal): Prefer sign-off on final quote text. Quick guardrails: avoid superlatives that aren't backed by run IDs (e.g., "lowest"). Safe phrasing example: "best observed in our tests". Also include run IDs in the fact-check doc.

Samir Gupta: Adding run IDs here for verification: run-20260602-1a, run-20260603-2b (both same infra: A100-80GB, 4k context, fp16+quant). Will attach the perf logs to the fact-check doc by EOD.

Maya Chen: Thanks — I've added a new tab to the Quick Facts doc called "Fact-check" and pasted Samir's runs. Also putting the embargoed excerpt we want to seed with analysts: 

```quote
"Redwood Inference reduces inference cost by up to 3x on common LLM workloads while maintaining production latency SLOs."
```

Maya Chen: Intention is to use that in analyst materials and press packets under embargo. Please call out objections now.

Aaron Patel: That phrasing works but tiny nit: use the multiplication sign "3×" for the copy deck. Also add parenthetical hardware note: (A100-80GB, fp16+quant) so analysts can contextualize.

Lena Ortiz: Agreed. Also can we have the quote attributed like: "— Aaron Patel, Head of Product"? PR prefers a short attribution line for the analyst packet.

Jordan (Legal): Attribution is fine. I'll do a quick legal pass on the final quote text tomorrow morning. If you include the run IDs and perf logs in the fact-check tab, that's sufficient for our audit trail.

Maya Chen: Plan: everyone drop your final quote + one-line approval in this thread by 12:00 PT tomorrow. PR will only distribute the analyst list and materials under embargo once Legal confirms. I'll compile quotes into the press packet (single doc) and add an approval column.

PR Bot: Reminder scheduled — internal briefing: 2026-06-08 09:00 PT; embargo lift: 2026-06-10 15:00Z.

Jordan (Legal): I'll review final quotes and the fact-check tab by 11:30 PT next day.

Samir Gupta: Fact-check checklist I'll send tonight: model config, dataset snapshot, perf logs, and verification steps. Will flag anything that looks inconsistent.

Aaron Patel: Draft quote in thread: "Redwood Inference reduces per-token inference cost by up to 3× on common LLM workloads (A100-80GB, fp16+quant) while meeting production latency SLOs." — Aaron Patel, Head of Product. Please review + approve.

Lena Ortiz: Approved from comms POV. No blockers.

Jordan (Legal): Approved pending inclusion of run IDs and perf logs in fact-check tab.

Maya Chen: Perfect — locking this as the approved analyst quote once Samir uploads the logs. Everyone: drop any final concerns now. :rocket:
